usedFor: A new Klaviyo campaign shares its brief or creative from Google Drive as a link.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign” in Klaviyo, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new campaign maps to a document people need, and the action returns a link.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens the file to anyone with the link, so check the access level first.
